**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

Instagram Reel transcription is here: paste or send any public Instagram Reel URL to get its spoken transcript automatically.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Direct Reel Transcription**: Paste or send public Instagram Reel links (`https://www.instagram.com/reel/...`) in chat to automatically extract the audio and transcribe spoken words via Whisper.
- **Link-only & Zero Server**: Works 100% client-side inside Obsidian mobile using native network requests and OpenAI Whisper — no local binaries, ffmpeg, or server setup required.
- **Settings › Extensions**: New Extensions tab in settings with an easy toggle (`Instagram Reels transcription`) and helpful status hints.
- **Agent Mode Support**: Autonomous agents can now call `fetch_reel_transcript` to analyze reel contents directly.
